Frequently Asked Questions

Order kaise place karna hai?

Product page par “Buy Now — Cash on Delivery” dabayein. WhatsApp me product ka naam aur price pehle se likha hoga; bas apna naam, phone aur address bhej dein.

Payment kaise hogi?

Rs. 200 delivery fee advance dena optional hai. Agar advance na dein, to product price aur delivery fee dono parcel receive karte waqt Cash on Delivery me pay karein.

Delivery kahan aur kitne din me hoti hai?

Hamare tamam products local Pakistani sellers se hain — is liye 3–5 din nationwide delivery hoti hai. Delivery fee Rs. 200 per order hai aur Cash on Delivery all Pakistan available hai.

Return ka kya process hai?

7-day easy returns available hain. Parcel receive karne ke 7 din ke andar product aur order details ke saath WhatsApp par contact karein; team next steps guide karegi.

Multiple products ka order kaise hoga?

Har product par “Add to Cart” dabayein. Cart me quantity adjust karke “Order All on WhatsApp” se sab products ek hi message me bhej dein. Online payment ya checkout nahi hai.
